notes.title: New Steam deckbuilder Stray Path is a stylish, FreeCell inspired roguelike
notes.content:
When I think of card games now, my brain springs to roguelike deckbuilders such as Balatro and Slay the Spire, or perhaps to CCGs like Hearthstone. But in my youth, 'PC card games' meant the digital renditions of Solitaire, Bridge, and FreeCell that came with your Windows install. Combining the two, stylish new strategy game Stray Path appeals to both my young and old self at once, and it's out now on Steam with a special discount for launch.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
New roguelike Stray Path blends Slay the Spire and Solitaire, and it's out soon

notes.title: V1.0.07 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players

Thank you all for your support and valuable feedback! As an independent developer, I will continue to update and improve the game, working hard to resolve any issues you encounter. Feel free to join the community and communicate with me directly—it helps me understand and address your feedback more quickly and effectively.

[h1]Update Details:[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the achievement "Have 5 poisoned enemies present at the same time" could not be triggered.
[*] Corrected the description of the enemy's Armor ability: Any damage taken will be capped at 15 instead of 10.
[*] Fixed an issue where attacks achieved through Rage did not count towards the "Reach 100 Attack in the game" achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue where killing all enemies in the same stage was being counted multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug where the boss room in stage 3 would sometimes fail to spawn monsters.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ninja Dummy would display "-1" in the slots after using up.
[*] Fixed an issue where the achievement "Complete a stage without taking any damage" was being unlocked incorrectly.
[*] Fixed the sequence of the Cave Boss's Parasitic Eye ability and attack triggering, ensuring the Parasitic ability triggers after attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where the shop displayed incorrect attribute values when carrying the Double Attribute Emblems.
[/list]
[h2]Balance & Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The attribute bonus from the Attribute Change Altar has been doubled.
[*] Removed the Chaos Curse from the Cursed Room.
[/list]
If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam—it means a lot to independent developers!

Have fun, and happy gaming!

notes.title: New roguelike Stray Path blends Slay the Spire and Solitaire, and it's out soon
notes.content:
Card games and roguelikes go together like butter on bread. The unpredictability of a deck of cards and the endless replayability of my favorite genre naturally complement each other, and that's why we see so many excellent examples on Steam. There's Balatro, Slay the Spire, Monster Train, Wildfrost, and even Inscryption. Every one of these games thrives on doing something unique, and I can easily say the same for Stray Path. Blending roguelikes with FreeCell Solitaire, the game is coming to Steam incredibly soon, and there's a demo you can try right now.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: We're excited to announce the release date for Stray Path!
notes.content:
[h1]🐱Stray Path will be releasing on Steam on Thursday, 6 February 2025 14:00 GMT![/h1]

Not all cities are ruled from the top - sometimes the strings are being pulled from the seedy back alleys of the towns themselves. Stray Path takes players on a journey through dark roads and twisted forests, where every choice is crucial as they attempt to  find a way out amidst countless dangers and secrets.

From curious cats to buff beast tamers, players must select an adventurer and embark on their adventure. One by one, cards are flipped and the mysteries of the path ahead are revealed. Will there be treasure? Vicious adversaries? Or perhaps even a chance to run? Every decision has a consequence.

[h3]💸Launch discounts![/h3]

There will be a launch discount, as well as an extra discount if you pick up the game alongside [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2346410/Border_Pioneer/]Border Pioneer[/url], another strategy game published by Gamersky and Yogscast Games, that will be launching at the same time!

You can watch the release date trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SD8tXQk5rRU]here[/url]. Save the date!

notes.title: Demo V0.40 Updates
notes.content:
Hello friends,
I am the game developer, Fan.

It's been almost a month, I and Fat Onino are really happy to see so many people are following our update, we thank you again for your love and support!

During this time, we added art for some monsters and relics. The third level was also updated. Also, there were tons of optimization and adjustment. 

Indie game development is a tough way to go. We need your suggestions and opinions to perfect the Stray Path. It would be grateful to have you joining our Discord at :[url=https://discord.gg/cSTaTdKVWf]https://discord.gg/cSTaTdKVWf[/url]
[h2]Levels Update[/h2]
- Third level: Mysterious Valley
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44654975/3ce8c214fa8e98dabfbd78a1dd83270e06bac542.png[/img]
- New enemies: Bomb Slime, Can, Fish, Stone, Swamp, Mystery, Lizard Mage, Troll, Corruption and Leshen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44654975/0c4e2468790c750dd8f0feb376f1ea3751cc3324.jpg[/img]
- Replaced appearance of some enemies.
- Adjusted rooms in different levels. Now there are 4 types of rooms: Altar, Elite, Resource and Shop. Changed functions and rewards for different rooms. 
[h2]Relic Update[/h2]
- New relics: Fairy Wand, Champion Gloves, Sprinter Shoes, Tumbler Toy, Ninja Dummy, Bounty Hat, First Aid, Dragon Egg, Drake, Lucky Probe, Alloy Stick, Inflatable Mushroom, Mushroom Potion and Slime Bomb.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44654975/07b5870f1a1068c3b0ad9de117d5ea398e8dda3b.jpg[/img]
- Changed effects or values for some relics: Natural Shield, Magic Mushroom, Eye, Blue Gem, Assassin Cloak and Black Book.
- Changed names and icons for some relics.
[h2]UI update[/h2]
- Changed Game start menu changed.
- Added some sound effects.
- Changed Character picking interface.
- Character picking interface had a new Journal system entry.
- Character picking interface had a new original relics selection panel. You can select the character-only relics to start with. Those relics need to be unlocked in the Journal system.
[h2]Journal System[/h2]
- Added Journal system. There are three types now: Rogue Catty Journal, Adventure Journal and Relic Journal. You can use souls to unlock Journal items to add extra content.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44654975/f1ddc41e7eb202f0b31f55fccc3e7380ea1b1680.png[/img]
- If you die or reach the final room in the game, you will be rewarded with souls regarding your game progress. Souls can be used to upgrade Journal.
[h2]Optimization[/h2]
- Game rendering changed from Vulkan to Opengl, supporting lower end PCs running the game.
- More language support and multi-lingual UI fitness.
- Fortune was overhauled: now kill the enemy will gain gold, same as Fortune value.
- Relic upgrade altar increased preview function. Putting relic on the altar will show preview, then you need to confirm for upgrade. You can always pull off the relic on the altar.
- Relic inventory increased to 12 slots. Extra 2 slots need to be unlocked in Journal.
- The attribute panel will prompt colour changes when your attribute is changed.
- Visual fixes: Pick up relic or cards, your cursor will change.
- Relic recycle and card recycle are all scaled to 3 golds. Added a recycle price tip.
- Optimized clicking card logic, fixed some bugs about fast clicking the cards.
- Optimized card applying scenario logic. Now the item cards will be added to card inventory first.
- Added a countdown to enemy ability rounds.
- Fixed the bug that switching relics from altar would cause a game break.
- Fixed some other bugs.
- Updated some game text.
